sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Duel-GX, also known as Crabby by Michele, is one of the Six Armors created by a scientist from another world, who landed in the region of Lizeria in order to stop the Ten-Winged Tormentor known as Melchio from destroying the worlds.

sections.title: History
sections.content:
Before it landed in Grand Gaia, Duel-GX was the first installment of the Six Armor made by a certain scientist from another world. After Melchio destroyed their world, the gate to other worlds opened. Duel-GX, along with Melchio and the other two armors were absorbed into the gate to Grand Gaia.

Melchio and Duel-GX arrived in Lizeria, where Melchio immediately destroyed a village and went on a rampage in order to destroy the worlds. To stop Melchio's action, Duel-GX decided to go with Michele, after the latter insisted to the armor that she can't stand Melchio's action.

During the fight against Melchio, Duel-GX and its comrades suffered a great loss. That was when it remember the program Reis had installed inside it: Code 666. Duel-GX then evolved into Duel-SGX and chased Melchio. As it started charging its power, Michele came and yelled at it, trying to halt Duel-GX from sacrificing itself. However, the charging process couldn't be stopped. When the charging process was completed, Duel-GX said "Thank you, Michele." and exploded together with Melchio.

sections.title: Character
sections.content: Not much known about Duel-GX's character, due to its similarity with machine. But since Duel-GX decided to protect Michele at all costs, Duel-GX has shown some affection towards its "master".
